visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing purple mouse ears and a white crochet top sits on a green park bench, carefully braiding the hair of a toddler girl. The girl is dressed in an elaborate purple and pink princess gown with sequin details. They are outdoors with green foliage and a decorative fence in the background. (2) The camera moves to a close-up shot of the woman's hands as she uses colorful floral hair clips to secure the girl's pigtails. The girl looks down at a pink object in her hands, appearing calm and patient. (3) The toddler girl is seen sitting alone on the bench, looking toward the camera with a playful expression, putting a finger to her lips in a silencing gesture. A young boy and other park visitors are visible in the soft-focus background. (4) The scene shifts to the girl standing on a brick-paved walkway. She twirls and walks slowly, holding the hem of her large, ruffled skirt. The woman follows closely, holding her hand and assisting her movement. (5) Multiple cuts show the pair walking through different sections of the park, with the girl occasionally stopping to look at the ground or adjust her dress. Passers-by are seen sitting on nearby benches. (6) The final shot is a static photo-style frame of the woman and the girl posing in front of a large, colorful fairytale castle under a clear blue sky. The woman has her arms outstretched and both are smiling.
